{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Wild Fire''''' was a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] used by the remnants of the [[Disac pirates]]. It was armed with a [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannon]] and [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]]. Along with two [[MRX-BR Pacifier]]s, the ''Wild Fire'' led an attack on [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] travelling the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
